elaine: Heads-up — we've had 12 OOMs on runtime-prod-3 since the v2.14 kernel-router rollout (2026-03-17). Pattern looks like KV cache stripe growth during longctx workloads.

kevin: Can you paste the logs and any pprof output?

elaine: Stack snippets attached below, pprof shows large retained heap in kv::stripe::Shard::alloc_sequence.
```
runtime-prod-3 | OOM killed process pid=2145 signal=9
runtime: kv stripe enlarge: old=8 new=24 mem_delta=+1.8GB
backtrace:
  kv::stripe::Shard::alloc_sequence+0x1f4
  kernel_router::select_kernels+0x3b2
  runtime::serve_request+0x98
```

samir: CI perf-check flagged this too — perf/job/longctx-mem reported +18% resident set vs baseline after the same rollout. Repro locally with seqlen=8192 and burst=16.

anshuman: I started a git-bisect on the staging branch. First failing commit that correlates with the regression is 7a9d8b2 — "adaptive-kernel-selection: prefer bigger kernels for small batches". It changes the kernel selection heuristics and the prefetch path for KV shards.

ci-bot: [perf-check] memory-increase: 18.2% > threshold 10% — check failed.

deploy-bot: Rollout hold: flagged for eng-runtime (auto-block because ci/perf failed).

kevin: If bisect points to 7a9d8b2, can we try reverting that on canary? Quick test: revert+rebuild on staging to confirm.

samir: Did a quick revert on staging (local revert of 7a9d8b2) — OOMs stop, KV stripe counts stable under the longctx harness. So revert reduces memory but doesn't address underlying allocator accounting issue.

elaine: Proposed action: 1) Open rollback PR for v2.14 canary (git revert --no-commit 7a9d8b2), 2) pause remaining rollout, 3) root-cause: kernel selection change amplified prefetch across stripes causing over-allocation under high seqlen/burst, 4) mid-term fix: tighten stripe prefetch accounting + add unit and perf tests for seqlen distribution.

kevin: I'll open the rollback PR and add the rollback tag. Also adding a short perf test to CI that runs seqlen=4k/8k profiles.

anshuman: I'll draft a follow-up patch that: a) bounds prefetch per-shard by total cache budget, b) adds a slow-path that rejects multi-stripe prefetch if mem-pressure flagged.

elaine: Thanks — marking as rollout-blocker and assigning to @kevin and @anshuman.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3125 (revert 7a9d8b2). Triggering canary redeploy now.

deploy-bot: Canary redeploy started for runtime-prod-3.

samir: After canary rollback verification: mem profile back to baseline, no OOMs in 2h stress run. We'll keep the rollout paused until the follow-up patch lands.

elaine: Good. Follow-up: add a perf-gate in CI for memory regressions >10% for longctx suite.

kevin: Will add the gate and metrics dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/kv/growth

ci-bot: Noted — will fail PRs that exceed the gate once enabled.

elaine: Closing immediate incident — leaving this thread for coordination on the proper fix and tests.
